name: BharatRohan Airborne Innovations Ltd
about: Incorporated in June 2016, BharatRohan Airborne Innovations Limited is an agritech solutions provider focusing on drone/UAV platforms and Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) technology.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
BharatRohan Airborne Innovations Ltd is an agritech company that provides drone/UAV-based crop intelligence (hyperspectral imaging) and sells related agri-inputs and agri-outputs.
Its flagship offerings are CropAssure (crop monitoring + ICM advisory powered by hyperspectral DSS) and SourceAssure (procurement/sale of residue-low traced farm produce).

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 44.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 254 days to 374 days
